gloss: stocking up; hoarding; buying in advance

definitions.gloss: stocking up; buying in advance; hoarding
definitions.explanation: purchasing and storing supplies in advance, especially in anticipation of shortages, emergencies, or price increases

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}いだめ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stocked up on food before the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{買|か}いだめ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More people are stocking up before the price increase.

examples.japanese: {買|か}いだめ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧になった。
examples.english: Items went out of stock due to hoarding.

notes:
FORMS:
- {買|か}い (buying)
- ⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧ ({溜|た}め - storing, accumulating)

USAGE:
While ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧ is neutral (efficient shopping), {買|か}いだめ often has a slightly negative connotation when it involves panic buying or hoarding that affects supply for others.
Commonly seen before natural disasters, during pandemics, or before announced price increases.
- {買|か}いだめ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {買|か}いだめ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stock up, to hoard)
- {買|か}いだめ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to rush to stock up)
